create_LogisticRegression_fit_predict: create a LogisticRegression model, fit it on training data, and predict on test data
build_LogisticRegressionCV_cross_validat: build a LogisticRegressionCV estimator with cross-validation to tune C and l1_ratio hyperparameters
run_logistic_regression_path_sweep: run _logistic_regression_path to compute coefficients across a grid of C regularization values
test_LogisticRegression_predict_proba: test the LogisticRegression predict_proba method to return class probability estimates
review_LogisticRegressionCV_score: review the LogisticRegressionCV score method that evaluates the model using the configured scoring metric
